header.name: PatrixWorld Sampler [VARFIX v0.2.2]
header.description: v0.2.2 VARFIX — the variations weren't actually taking effect in v0.2.0/v0.2.1. Root cause from MS Learn docs + Bedrock Wiki: blocks.json needs format_version 1.21.110+ AND each block needs an explicit 'textures' field pointing to its terrain_texture.json shortname. Without that, Bedrock falls through to a lookup path that bypasses the variations array. Fixed both. Bumped blocks.json to format_version 1.21.120. Added explicit texture mappings for all 21 variation-enabled blocks (stone, dirt, sand, gravel, cobblestone, grass_block, mycelium, sandstone+red_sandstone, mud family, etc.). Variants should now be visible in-game. Carries v0.2.1 SMOOTH (16 median-filtered CTM variants + lava flipbook + sandstone port).
